bio.en: A record of questions, tools, and work worth keeping.
bio.zh: 在这里记录值得留下的问题、工具与作品。

now.en: Organizing reading notes and refining this blog’s first collection of posts.
now.zh: 正在整理阅读笔记，并打磨这个博客的第一批文章。

en: Turning scattered notes into paths of knowledge I can revisit.
This project values lightweight structure, clear links, and steady accumulation.
zh: 把零散笔记整理成可以回访的知识路径。
这个项目关注轻量的结构、清晰的链接与长期积累。

description.en: A living index of notes, research, and creative work.
description.zh: 一个持续更新的笔记、研究与作品索引。

en: Books I have read are not a row of titles, but an evolving network of relationships.
zh: 读过的书并不是一排书名，而是一张不断生长的关联网络。

description.en: A visual index for organizing reading notes by theme and question.
description.zh: 用主题与问题组织读书笔记的可视化索引。
